buffer: EBX flat pointer (DEC-04a); AL sector count, CX packed CHS, DH head, DL BIOS drive
geometry: fixed 16 heads / 63 sectors; cylinders = min(1024, IDENTIFY LBA28 sectors / 1008), at least one
origin: device LBA zero, no mounted-volume base; prefix sectors accessible
error: CF set, AH BIOS status; success clears CF; AH15 returns AH03 and CX:DX capacity, absent fixed disk AH00/CX:DX=0/CF clear
parameters: AH08 returns maximum CH/CL/DH, DL attached fixed disks, AH00/CF clear; absent drive AH07/CF set and CX/DX zero
write_coherence: successful writes overlapping mounted volume notify fileio_fat_absdisk_written with volume-relative overlap only
sources: IBM PS/2 and PC BIOS Interface Technical Reference April 1987 pp2-58..61,2-64,2-67; docs/research/block-device-ground-truth.md
